description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores of different models across various datasets, comparing the performance of MADLLM with its variants, MADLLM without feature embedding and MADLLM without skip embedding. The horizontal axis lists the categories, namely PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL, while the vertical axis represents the F1 score as a percentage, ranging from 80 to 100 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of three bars: green for MADLLM, purple for MADLLM without feature embedding, and orange for MADLLM without skip embedding. The F1 scores for MADLLM are approximately 93.5 for PSM, 91 for SWaT, 93.5 for SMAP, and 93.5 for MSL. The bars for MADLLM without feature embedding have values around 90 for PSM, 86 for SWaT, 90.5 for SMAP, and 90 for MSL, while the bars for MADLLM without skip embedding have values around 91 for PSM, 87 for SWaT, 90.5 for SMAP, and 90 for MSL. The bars are grouped by category, with the three models represented side by side for each dataset, and are not sorted in any particular order. No bars are visually emphasized.
